scope: Synthetic local Miniflare; all() reads only; first() excluded. Equal one new article; older-than-memory unrelated history; no inference. Raw snapshots intentionally differ in prior; effective reader memory is equal.

queries.sql: SELECT e.json FROM v1_feed_documents e JOIN v1_feed_documents p ON p.kind='publication_status' AND p.id=e.id AND p.feed_id=e.feed_id WHERE e.feed_id=? AND e.kind='editions' AND json_extract(p.json,'$.status')='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY e.id

SELECT e.json AS item,r.json AS revision FROM v1_evidence e JOIN v1_intake_scopes s ON s.id=e.feed_source_id JOIN v1_revisions r ON r.id=json_extract(e.json,'$.currentRevisionId') WHERE s.feed_id=? AND json_extract(e.json,'$.state')='ACTIVE' AND json_extract(s.json,'$.enabled')=1 AND json_extract(s.json,'$.deletedAt') IS NULL ORDER BY json_extract(r.json,'$.acceptedAt'),r.id
SELECT json FROM v1_feed_documents WHERE feed_id=? AND kind=? ORDER BY id

SELECT r.id,json_extract(i.json,'$.observation.observedAt') observedAt FROM v1_revisions r JOIN v1_intake_scopes s ON s.id=r.feed_source_id LEFT JOIN v1_inputs i ON i.id=json_extract(r.json,'$.sourceObservationId') AND i.feed_source_id=r.feed_source_id WHERE s.feed_id=? AND r.id IN (?)

SELECT json_extract(json,'$.window') AS window_json FROM v1_feed_documents WHERE feed_id=? AND kind='briefing_requests' AND (json_extract(json,'$.state') IS NOT 'DONE' OR json_extract(json,'$.result')='DEFERRED') ORDER BY id
